names.zh: 埃尔帕莱索（奇永谷，比较址）

kind_note: Comparative Late Preceramic monumental site outside Norte Chico four-valley core
region: Chillón Valley, central coast Peru (south of Norte Chico core)

summary.zh: 奇永谷晚前陶纪念性遗址；Quilter 等 1991 报告混合海洋（凤尾鱼为主）与栽培植物（含大量棉花）生计——比较性，非北奇科四谷核心。
summary.en: Chillón Valley Late Preceramic monumental site; Quilter et al. 1991 report mixed marine (anchovy-dominated) and cultivated plants including extensive cotton—comparative, not Norte Chico four-valley core.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-24; bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalogs; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
